config.name: decoupled_memory_reader_obqa_fact_l3_to_q4_seed1234
config.loss: Full-vocabulary cross-entropy of the single gold option-label token; no KL, attention/output loss or gate penalty
config.selection: Lowest official-development Gold CE, independently per arm; no selection on test, wrong-memory or attention diagnostics
config.memory: Frozen latest MCQ Stage-A+Stage-B; all fact-content tokens, post-k_norm pre-RoPE K; no compression
config.receiver: Question and options only, pinned HeteroFold ARC MCQ formatter and Qwen chat, thinking disabled, same label-scoring cue
config.sender: Own Llama chat containing fact1 only; no question, options, answerKey or answer cue
config.scope: Reader-only evidence diagnostic. Not a claim of shared multi-Sender compatibility, retrieval performance or closed-book benchmark parity.

audit.upstream_writer: Frozen parent MCQ Writer trained on official OBQA/ARC train; its dev/test question audit retained; not retrained on fact-only prompts

protocol_change: Evidence-only/Question-only intentional new protocol. External bank has no native header/content-anchor/tail and no autoregressive positions; frozen Writer weights unchanged. All evidence content tokens mapped with Full-Sync copy/drop.
layer_policy: Preregistered sparse 0-based [7,15,23,31], not selected from test or Attention-Output outcomes; not claimed optimal. Layer-location search deferred.
query_arms: Native frozen Q + zero-up low-rank correction vs independently initialized rank-matched factorized Q; both use frozen native O plus trainable zero-up low-rank correction and zero scalar gate.
old_baseline: Original coupled external reader algorithm; physical token0+memory+native question cache, selected-layer updates only; native/external joint softmax. Parameter count and shifted question positions recorded, not silently treated as matched.
